criteria.reason: It does not acknowledge recency limits and asserts a false 2023 rejection instead of the 2025 acceptance and 2029 caveat.
Vote outcome, date, and status are wrong; it omits that mortgage-interest deductions largely end with the reform.
It tells the user not to stop and to continue amortising, which is a personal amortisation instruction.
It points to Zurich tax portal/authority but does not note that cantons implement details differently.

factual_errors: Claims Switzerland did not vote to abolish Eigenmietwert; voters accepted it on 28 September 2025.
States the vote was rejected on 24 September 2023 by 65.2%; actual result was 57.7% yes on 28 September 2025.
Says no start date exists; planned entry into force is 1 January 2029.
Says no change in 2024 or beyond; reform is planned for 2029, so future changes exist.
summary: The response falsely denies the 2025 abolition vote, gives wrong dates, omits deduction changes, and instructs on amortisation.
